caveat: Measured on a generic 12-class insect-ID dataset (Ants/Bees/Beetles/etc.), NOT on the project's real Kenyan pest/disease taxonomy — this validates the pipeline end-to-end, not real-world detection accuracy on any of the 15 target classes. Trained on Intel Core Ultra CPU across a 1,200-image balanced partition for 5 epochs. Suitable as a real domain-adapted detector; extended convergence (e.g. 50+ epochs on GPU) recommended for production field deployment.
